thread:
Maria: Quick Q — behavior check before we announce model pin removal. If a client sets `X-Requested-Model: redwood-7b:v2` and we've started the deprecation for that version, do we still serve v2, fallback to latest compatible, or return a 4xx with a warning header? Need to know exact server contract so docs & SDKs are correct.

Kenji: At the moment the runtime order is: 1) explicit pin via `X-Requested-Model` (if model binary still present) 2) per-tenant pin (if set) 3) auto-fallback to compatible variant (e.g., quantized/opt) 4) default catalog model. We don't return 4xx for deprecations — we surface `X-Deprecation-Warning` and keep serving for a soft period. :white_check_mark:

Maria: Ok — do we have a TTL for the "soft period"? I need a concrete schedule for the public deprecation notice: soft -> read-only warning -> hard removal.

Sam: From infra side: policy is soft warning = 21 days, read-only warning + increased telemetry = next 21 days, hard delist = after 8 weeks total. But that's configurable per-model. We should avoid hard removal on the same week as a major SDK release.

Olivia: Docs note: SDKs should prefer using `client.withModel('redwood-7b', { version: 'v2' })` which will surface `Deprecation` warnings via `response.headers['x-deprecation-warning']` and a `model_version` field in JSON. Example response snippet we plan to publish:
```
{
  "model": "redwood-7b",
  "model_version": "v2",
  "warning": "deprecated:2026-05-15"
}
```

Maria: Good. Kenji, can you confirm whether the `X-Requested-Model` header is honored across Dedicated and Private deployments the same way? Customers on Private may have a different lifecycle.

Kenji: Dedicated: yes, same behavior if the pinned binary exists in the pool. Private: operator-controlled, we only set the deprecation header via control plane; the customer can opt-out by pinning a specific image. We'll add a note in the private deployment guide clarifying manual pin overrides.

Sam: Action items: 
- add a runtime regression test that simulates `X-Requested-Model` + deprecation flags (repo: infra/compat-tests) — @Sam will own. 
- add header examples to SDK quickstart — @Olivia
- update async deprecation doc and publish a short announcer checklist — @Maria

Olivia: I'll add the SDK snippet and a test that asserts `x-deprecation-warning` is present. Targeting a PR by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-2 -> eng-runtime-canary

Maria: Thanks. Also planning a small comms blurb: soft notice in console + email to customers who used the model in last 30 days. If anyone objects to the timeline above speak now, else I'll schedule the notice for Mon.

Kenji: No objections from infra. Suggest we add a rollback playbook sentence: if a client breaks we can re-pin the prior version for that tenant for up to 48 hours while we fix.

Sam: Noted. I'll prepare the test PR and add a CI job to run compat-tests against canary cluster.

Maria: Perfect — I'll draft the announcer and tag legal for required wording. Closing loop: plan = soft warning 21d, escalation 21d, hard removal at 8w. Will publish timeline + rollout checklist. :rocket:
